name: Ahsan Manzil & Sadarghat River Walk
about: Visit the Pink Palace, the old riverside seat of the Nawabs of Dhaka, then walk to Sadarghat and take a short wooden boat ride on the Buriganga. Museum ticket, boat ride, local guide and lunch of Old Dhaka bakarkhani and tea included.

name: Lalbagh Fort & Dhakeshwari Temple
about: Walk through the unfinished Mughal fort with the tomb of Pari Bibi, the Diwan-i-Aam and the old mosque, then visit the national temple of Dhaka. Entry tickets, guide and a traditional Old Dhaka lunch included.

name: Jatiya Sangsad Bhaban & Hatirjheel
about: See the National Parliament House designed by Louis Kahn, one of the great buildings of South Asia, then relax by the lake at Hatirjheel at sunset. Guided architecture walk and a local dinner included.

name: Atia Mosque & Tangail Saree Village
about: Visit the 17th-century terracotta Atia Mosque, then see handloom weavers at work in a Tangail saree village. You can buy sarees directly from the weavers. AC bus from Dhaka, guide and lunch included.

name: Shilaidaha Kuthibari & Lalon Akhra
about: Visit the riverside house where Rabindranath Tagore wrote many of his poems and stories, then the shrine of Baul saint Lalon Shah in Kushtia. Padma river boat ride, hotel stay and meals included.

name: Tungipara Mausoleum & Gopalganj
about: Pay respects at the mausoleum complex of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman in Tungipara, his birthplace, and see the lake and museum of the complex. Comfortable transport over the Padma Bridge, guide and lunch included.

name: Tajhat Palace & Rangpur Heritage
about: Tour the red Tajhat Palace of the old Rangpur zamindars and its museum, then see the Rangpur town, Begum Rokeya's birthplace at Pairabondh and the Teesta bank. Hotel stay, breakfast and local transport included.

name: Banglabandha & Tetulia Tea Garden
about: Travel to the northernmost tip of Bangladesh. Walk the green tea slopes of Tetulia, stand at Banglabandha with the Himalaya view on clear days and try fresh local tea. Hotel stay, meals and transport included.

name: Varendra Museum & Padma Garden
about: Explore the Varendra Research Museum, the oldest museum in Bangladesh, then walk the Padma river garden at sunset and taste Rajshahi mango sweets and silk. Hotel stay, breakfast and rickshaw tour included.

name: Hum Hum Waterfall Trek
about: Trek through tea estates and jungle streams to the tall Hum Hum waterfall in Kamalganj. Best in the rainy months. Local guide, packed lunch, simple resort stay and transport from Srimangal included.

name: Madhabpur Lake & Tea Estates
about: Boat on the clear green Madhabpur Lake surrounded by tea hills, then walk the tea gardens nearby and have seven-colour tea. Boat ride, guide and lunch included.

name: Shah Jalal Dargah & Keane Bridge
about: Visit the shrine of Hazrat Shah Jalal, feed the holy catfish at the pond, walk across Keane Bridge over the Surma River and try Sylheti shatkora beef. Guide, transport and lunch included.

name: Satchari National Park Safari
about: Walk the forest trails of Satchari to look for the hoolock gibbon, the Phayre's leaf monkey and many birds, and visit the Khasia and Tripura villages nearby. Forest ticket, guide and lunch included.

name: Birishiri & Susang Durgapur
about: See the blue Someshwari river, the white clay hills of Birishiri and the Garo villages and Susang palace ruins of Durgapur. Hotel stay in Netrokona, breakfast and local transport included.

name: Nijhum Dwip Wildlife Island
about: Cross the river mouth by trawler to Nijhum Dwip, an island of deer, mangrove and wide empty beaches. Ride buffalo carts, see the spotted deer and stay in an island resort. Boat tickets, meals and stay included.

name: Sonadia Island Day Trip
about: Take a boat from Moheshkhali channel to Sonadia, a sandy island of crabs, shells and migratory birds. Best seen from November to March. Boat ride, snacks and beach guide included.

name: Kutubdia Island & Lighthouse
about: Go by boat to Kutubdia, climb the old lighthouse, visit the wind turbines, salt fields and fishing villages and enjoy a quiet beach night. Boat tickets, hotel and meals included.

name: Ramu Buddhist Temples
about: Visit the golden Buddhist viharas of Ramu, the huge sitting Buddha at the Ramu Buddhist Temple and the handicraft makers of Ramu, then end the day at the beach in Cox's Bazar. Guide and lunch included.

name: Parki Beach Anwara
about: A black-sand beach on the Bay of Bengal on the south bank of the Karnaphuli, with seafood stalls and long sunsets. Includes a trip by a country boat across the river, a seafood lunch and transport from Chattogram city.

name: Sitakunda Chandranath Hill & Eco Park
about: Climb the steps to Chandranath Temple for views of the sea and the plains, then walk Sitakunda Eco Park with its waterfalls and bamboo stairways. Entry tickets, guide and lunch included.

name: Bangabandhu Safari Park Gazipur
about: Drive through a large safari park near Dhaka with lions, tigers, elephants and deer. A good family day out with a walking zoo and picnic spots. Entry tickets, safari bus and lunch included.

name: Thanchi & Tindu Hill Trek
about: Take a jeep and boat on the Sangu river to Thanchi, then trek to Tindu village and view point in the deep Bandarban hills. Stay with local families. Permits, guide, meals and transport included.

name: Tajingdong Highest Peak Trek
about: Trek to Tajingdong (Saka Haphong), the highest peak of Bangladesh, through Bawm villages and deep forest. For fit trekkers only. Permits, local guides, camp food and trek permits arranged by us.

name: Shoilo Propat Waterfall & Meghla
about: Visit the cool Shoilo Propat waterfall on the Bandarban road and the Meghla Tourism Complex with its small zoo and sky view. Resort stay, breakfast, jeep and local guide included.

name: Alutila Cave & Richhang Waterfall
about: Walk into the dark Alutila cave of Khagrachhari with a torch and guide, then see Richhang waterfall and Tripura villages. Hotel stay, breakfast and chander gari jeep included.

name: Rajban Vihara & Shuvolong Waterfall
about: Visit the grand Rajban Vihara of the Chakma king, then take a boat across Kaptai Lake to the Shuvolong waterfall and hanging bridge. Boat ride, hotel and meals included.

name: Durga Sagar & Guthia Mosque
about: See Durga Sagar, a huge old pond with migratory birds, and the Guthia Mosque of Barishal with its fine carving. A launch ride on the river is included, with hotel stay and meals.

name: Bangabandhu Bridge & Jamuna Sunset
about: Watch the sun go down over the Jamuna from the sand banks near Bangabandhu Bridge. Includes a country boat ride, river-fish lunch and a short visit to Sirajganj Rabindra Kachari Bari.

name: Madhupur Forest & Garo Villages
about: Walk the sal forest of Madhupur National Park and visit Garo (Mandi) villages to see their homes, food and dance. Forest ticket, guide and lunch included.

name: Dulahazra Safari Park
about: See Asian elephants, deer and other animals in a large natural forest safari park between Chattogram and Cox's Bazar. Entry tickets, safari trip and lunch are included.
